summary: Five-phase plan built on the research report's measurements, not the task description's. Scope grew again during planning: the saturation layer is entirely dead (the report's SaturatedBFMCS/FlowFrame consumer is a false positive on TaskFrame.Saturation), so ModalSaturation.lean retires whole as a sixth dead file -- 6 files / 2,735 lines. Also caught: archiving these guard-first files falsifies Boneyard/README.md's tree-wide EVENT-FIRST banner (14 untl/snce occurrences), which the report does not mention. Phases: baseline capture; cycle break via IteratedTemporal.lean; ModalSaturation migration; retirement plus 28 archived-import re-points; documentation coherence. Phases 2 and 3 are parallel.
decisions_made: Retirement covers 6 files, not the report's 5 or the description's 3: ModalSaturation.lean's live helpers all migrate and its remaining 11 declarations are dead (re-measured; the report's FlowFrame consumer for SaturatedBFMCS does not exist)

The SuccRelation diary-deletion and F-21 docstring WORK items are unreachable as written under a 6-file retirement; discharged by recording them in the archive README rather than editing a file in the same phase it is archived
UltrafilterMCS.lean:26 included despite Metalogic/Algebraic/ being outside the stated file scope -- declared explicitly as a scope deviation
SetMaximalConsistent.* lemmas go to Metalogic/Core/MCSProperties.lean, not Theorems/ModalDerived.lean, to avoid widening the existing Theorems<->Metalogic edge
Theorems/ModalDerived.lean uses namespace FormalSystem.Theorems.ModalDerived per the sibling convention, so unqualified consumer call sites need an added open
Phases 3 and 4 declared Commit Mode atomic-batch -- their intermediate per-file states are necessarily red and must not be committed
Temporary module-invariants-manifest entries added in Phases 2 and 3 and deleted in Phase 4, since C6 fails both on unmanifested unreachable modules and on entries naming nonexistent ones
Phase 4 schedules an expected C5 failure on Bundle/README.md rather than pretending the gate is green there
dead_ends: Splitting the ModalSaturation migration into green sub-phases: the Bundle and Theorems.ModalDerived copies would be simultaneously in scope under identical names, so no green intermediate exists -- hence the atomic-batch declaration
